Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.scenario.hook

Interface GameplayHookService

public interface GameplayHookService
Gameplay hooks for ordinary addons, consulted in every running match without being a selected scenario.

The decision points are the same GameplayHooks scenarios use, with the same request and outcome rules. A handler registered here is consulted for a decision only after every active scenario of that match passed, so selected scenarios keep deciding first exactly as before. Among addon handlers, a higher priority is asked first and equal priorities keep registration order; the first answer that does not pass decides and the rest are not asked.

Handlers run on the thread of the decision - the main thread for every built-in hook - and must decide quickly. A handler that throws is treated as passing and the failure is logged under its owner; it stays registered. Registrations end on their own when the owning plugin disables. Lookups resolve the match from the request's player, block or entity, so a handler only ever sees decisions inside running Zentrix matches. 


 ZentrixAPI.get().getGameplayHookService().register(this, GameplayHooks.PLAYER_DAMAGE, 0,
     request -> request.cause().equals("FALL") ? HookOutcome.cancel() : HookOutcome.pass());
